name: RwlRwlRwlRwl!
summary: A keeper at the Library in Ironforge welcomes magical works for its collection. Your contributions help its knowledge grow.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: The keeper thanks you as magical works join the Library in Ironforge. Each addition broadens the knowledge held there. The keeper welcomes more works that may benefit the collection.

faq.q: What does the library keeper want?
faq.answer: The keeper welcomes magical works that may benefit the Library's collection.
The collection belongs to the Library in Ironforge.
Your contributions help the library's knowledge grow.
